title: NovaCorp Parental Leave & Adoption Policy
content:
NovaCorp Parental Leave and Family Bonding Policy — Effective March 1, 2025

1. ELIGIBILITY
All regular employees (full-time and part-time) who have been employed for at least 12 consecutive months are eligible for parental leave. Parental leave applies to the birth, adoption, or foster placement of a child.

2. PRIMARY CAREGIVER LEAVE
The primary caregiver is entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% of base salary. Leave must commence no later than 2 weeks after the birth or placement date. Primary caregiver leave may be taken in one continuous block or split into a maximum of two blocks within the first 12 months.

3. SECONDARY CAREGIVER LEAVE
The secondary caregiver is entitled to 6 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% of base salary. Secondary caregiver leave may be taken at any time within the first 12 months following birth or placement.

4. ADOPTION AND FOSTER CARE
Adoptive parents and foster parents receive the same parental leave entitlements as biological parents. The primary/secondary caregiver designation is determined by the employee in consultation with HR.

5. COORDINATION WITH STATE LEAVE
NovaCorp parental leave runs concurrently with any applicable state-mandated family leave. Where state law provides greater benefits, NovaCorp will supplement to ensure employees receive the full benefit described in this policy.

6. RETURN TO WORK
Employees returning from parental leave will be reinstated to the same or equivalent position with no loss of seniority. A re-onboarding meeting with the direct manager and HR is required within the first week of return.

7. NOTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS
Employees should notify HR and their manager as early as possible, but no later than 30 days before the expected start of parental leave, or as soon as practicable in case of unexpected birth or placement.
